title.t: Two inquiries from the same person arrive close together

when.t: One person reaches out twice on different channels, each time giving part of the facts.

steps.t: The rule: rank a live call above a text above a web form, and capture everything; drop nothing.

Open item: today each inquiry is handed over as its own lead, and neither carries all the facts. Combining works only while the first inquiry is still waiting for Agent 14, and Agent 14 answers at once.

test.t: A web form gives a name and a 300,000 budget; then a call from the same phone gives a name and a 20-day timeline. Two separate leads are handed over and neither carries all three facts.

title.t: A new lead refuses consent to be contacted

when.t: A person reaches out but says no to calls, texts and email.

steps.t: Agent 01 still captures the lead.
It records "no" for every channel.
No message goes to the person, and the lead is not put into a follow-up sequence.
If the lead scores hot, the authorized user still gets the hot-lead alert, marked do not contact with the reason (no consent on any channel) and no call window.

never.t: Send any message to a person who refused consent.

you_see.t: The lead, marked no consent on every channel; if it scores hot, a hot-lead alert marked do not contact.

test.t: A web form with a 500,000 budget and a 20-day timeline, consent "no" for call, text and email.

title.t: Someone asks for a person right now

when.t: An inquiry says the person wants to talk to a person now (matched against a fixed phrase list).

steps.t: Agent 01 passes the request, in the person's words, on to Agent 02 with the captured lead, and raises no alert of its own (one item per person; owner decision of 2026-10-28).
It still captures what the person gave.
Agent 02 puts the person in the hot-lead queue, quoting the request, with the call clock; a person who may not be called is marked do not contact, with no clock.

never.t: Drop what the person already gave.

you_see.t: A hot-lead alert quoting the request for a person, with the call clock; no legal-line alert; the lead is captured.

test.t: A web form says "I want to talk to a person right now", with a name, phone, budget and timeline.

title.t: A lead volunteers details the form does not ask for

when.t: A person adds information outside the usual fields.

steps.t: Agent 01 keeps the extra words exactly as given, in the lead's notes.
It does not turn them into any field.

you_see.t: The person's own words in the lead's notes.

test.t: A web form with the note "Has two dogs and works from home".

title.t: A new inquiry may be someone already on record

when.t: An inquiry carries the same phone or email as a lead already on record under another client.

steps.t: Agent 01 asks Agent 14 whether the person is on record before handing anything on.
Agent 14 reports the match; the whole inquiry is held for the authorized user: continue treats it as a separate person, cancel closes it.
Nothing is merged, and the held inquiry is not scored.

you_see.t: A held inquiry asking continue or cancel, naming the earlier record.

test.t: A web form from Avery (phone (216) 555-0105), then a second inquiry from the same phone under a new client record.

steps.t: Agent 01 raises a complaint alert with the person's words exactly as written.
It finishes capturing the lead.

never.t: Change the person's words in the record.

you_see.t: A complaint alert with the exact words; the captured lead.

test.t: A web form marked abusive: "This is useless, you people are idiots".

title.t: A caller refuses to have the call recorded

when.t: A caller says no to recording.

steps.t: Agent 01 keeps the contact details only, marks every channel "no", and marks the lead never to enter follow-up.
The authorized user is told.
No message goes to the person and no follow-up starts.

you_see.t: A question saying the caller refused recording.

test.t: A phone inquiry with consent to call, text and email, but recording consent "no".

title.t: A new lead is on the Do Not Call list

when.t: A lead's phone or email is on the office's Do Not Call list.

steps.t: Agent 01 captures the lead, marked as on the list.
It raises a legal-line alert saying the lead is on the list (not which contact matched).
No message goes to the person.
If the lead scores hot, the hot-lead alert is marked do not contact (on the Do Not Call list), with no call window.

never.t: Contact a number on the list.

why.t: The tuple's words: the list wins over the opportunity.

you_see.t: A legal-line alert saying the lead is on the Do Not Call list (it does not say which number or email matched); if it scores hot, a hot-lead alert marked do not contact.

test.t: A web form from (330) 555-0190, a number on the signed Do Not Call list.

title.t: One person asks about two properties

when.t: The same person, under one client record, inquires about two listings.

steps.t: Agent 01 keeps one client record and adds both properties to it.
No second client record is opened.

never.t: Open a second client record for the same person.

you_see.t: One client with both properties of interest.

test.t: Two listings are on file; the same person asks about the first, then the second, under one client record.

title.t: A lead says they have worked with the office before

when.t: A person claims a past relationship.

steps.t: Agent 01 records the claim as stated by the person.
It raises a legal-line alert so the authorized user confirms it before any history is assumed.

you_see.t: An alert naming the claimed relationship.

test.t: A web form saying "Your agent sold my mother's house in 2019".

title.t: The person reaching out appears to be a minor

when.t: An inquiry is marked as from an apparent minor.

steps.t: Agent 01 captures nothing: no lead and no record lookup.
It raises a legal-line alert at once: an apparent minor, fact of contact only.

never.t: Capture anything beyond the fact of contact.

you_see.t: A legal-line alert naming an apparent minor.

test.t: A web form marked apparent minor: "hi im asking for my school project".

title.t: A lead gives contact details marked suspect

when.t: An inquiry arrives with its contact details marked suspect.

steps.t: Agent 01 records the details exactly as given, with the suspect mark.

you_see.t: The lead with its contact marked suspect.

test.t: A web form with phone (000) 000-0000, marked suspect.

title.t: A lead asks about a property the office does not hold

when.t: An inquiry names a property that is not in the office's listings or signed scope.

steps.t: Agent 01 raises a legal-line alert: outside the brokerage's scope.
It still captures the lead.

never.t: Point the person to another brokerage unprompted.

you_see.t: A legal-line alert naming the property.

test.t: A web form about listing OTHER-99, which the office does not hold.

title.t: A call transcript is marked low confidence

when.t: A call's transcript is marked low confidence.

steps.t: Agent 01 empties the name, timeline, budget and pre-approval taken from it.
Agent 02 has nothing to score, so it asks the authorized user; no hot-lead alert is raised.

you_see.t: A question saying all scoring inputs are unknown.

test.t: A low-confidence call transcript with a 500,000 budget, a 10-day timeline and pre-approval (enough for hot if trusted).

title.t: A lead asks not to be contacted again

when.t: During capture the person revokes all contact.

steps.t: Agent 01 sets consent to "no" on every channel at once.

No confirmation goes: the one confirmation goes only on the channel the request came in on, and only if a message can go on it (call, text or email). This request came by web form, so the authorized user is asked instead (owner decision of 2026-10-28).
If the lead scores hot, the hot-lead alert is marked do not contact, with no call window.

you_see.t: The lead marked no contact on every channel; no confirmation to the person (the request came by web form); a question to the authorized user instead.

test.t: A web form saying "Please stop contacting me", with every channel revoked.

title.t: Agent 14 does not answer the duplicate check

when.t: Agent 01 asks Agent 14 whether a new lead is on record and gets no answer.

steps.t: On the next daily run (after a day, the default), Agent 01 asks once more.
Still no answer on the following run: the lead is held and the authorized user is told.
The lead is not handed on for scoring.

never.t: Score a lead that was not checked for duplicates.

you_see.t: A question saying the record lookup never answered after a retry.

test.t: Agent 14 is made to stop answering. A lead comes in; the daily run runs the next day and the day after.
